utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Thursday the seventeenth. Can you hear me, or am I talking to myself again?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: We can hear you. Bit tinny, but that's probably the portakabin.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: The heating in the portakabin is ridiculous. Freezing when you get in, then tropical by the time you've made a brew.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Good for drying your coat, though. About its only useful setting.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Anyway, the football last night. Honestly, ninety minutes I'm not getting back.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: You say that every week and still watch it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, well. Apparently I enjoy being disappointed.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I've got camping booked for the weekend. Looking at the weather, I'll be joining you on that.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Camping? This weekend? Brave.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: That's the polite word for it. Forecast's basically sideways rain.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Lovely. A wet tent and no decent kettle.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes the holiday complaints line, let's do the board.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: First, I've already swapped the filter on the Injection Moulding Line 2 yesterday. That's finished, not another job for today.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, that was still showing on my old view. That explains it.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: And I signed off the inspection on the Line 2 Pick and Place Robot on Tuesday. That one's closed as well.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Right, so neither of those is outstanding. Good.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Olumide, can you replace the seals on the booster pump by Monday? That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll replace the seals on the booster pump by Monday. Understood, that comes first.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Definitely the one hurting us. We're not getting round that production hold.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Just so we're clear, it's the seals we're talking about, not a whole pump replacement?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, the seals on the booster pump. Olumide has that, Monday, first priority.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: That's clear. I've got it.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: While we're on noises and pumps—well, not a pump actually. I heard a slight rattle from the CT1. Nothing to action yet, just an observation.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: A slight rattle, rather than a proper knock?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, slight. I'm not raising a job off it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. Observation only, not adding that to today's work.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Priya Raman, can you go to Northfield to pick up the replacement parts for the air dryer? That's fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll go to Northfield to pick up the replacement parts for the air dryer.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Sorry, you clipped out for me. Northfield?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Northfield, yes. The replacement parts for the air dryer.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Not another full dryer, then. I heard about half that sentence.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: No, just the parts. Teams is doing its underwater thing again.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, Priya Raman has the collection. Fairly important, but the booster pump remains the first job.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Got you. Audio's back now.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Um, I'll update the risk assessment for work on the Site Water System after lunch. That's fairly important.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: The assessment for the work, rather than changing the actual scope?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Exactly, the risk assessment. That's what I'm taking on.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Tomasz Nowak. Risk assessment for work on the Site Water System, after lunch, fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yep, agreed.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Can I just get the parts blocker in before we move off water?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, go on.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Still waiting on parts for the feedwater pump, nothing we can do until they arrive. The repair's still blocked; I'm not taking that as a new job today.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, no arrival to report from stores. Still waiting.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood on the repair. Separately, I'll inspect the feedwater pump for leaks today at 2pm. It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Just the inspection, Sarah? Not trying to do the repair without the bits?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. I'll inspect it for leaks, that's all. The parts blocker stays against the repair.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Right, those are separate things. Looking for leaks doesn't mean we've magically got the parts.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: If only saying it on Teams made them appear.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I'd have a much easier life, wouldn't I?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I'll run a function test on the fire panel this afternoon. Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: That's yours then, Saz? The fire panel function test?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, mine. This afternoon, normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Sorry, I spoke over you there. I thought you'd said that was at two as well.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No, today at 2pm is my feedwater pump leak inspection. The fire panel function test is this afternoon; I haven't put a particular time on that.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Ah, right. Two different entries. With you.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: And the parts wait doesn't change the leak inspection. All makes sense now.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. The two finished items stay closed, CT1 is just an observation, and the feedwater pump repair stays blocked.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yep. Nothing in that changes the booster pump being first for me.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. That's the lot, then. Thanks, everyone.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Cheers. Enjoy the tropical portakabin.
